info.title: Live Commerce catalog and inventory admin API
info.description: T04 merchant-only slice, not a complete SaaS/live-provider approval. Runtime requests derive Scope from a merchant session; client tenant headers and Host are not authority. No public reserve route.

get.description: Requires BOTH catalog:read and inventory:read in the same scoped transaction. q is a literal case-insensitive name/SKU substring (%, _, ! and backslash are literal); cursor binds store, warehouse, normalized q and status. Active warehouse required.

200.description: Scoped SKU-stock projection. No balance row returns zero values. Keyset cursor is not a snapshot.

product_version.description: catalog-media: expected_version for PATCH/archive of the product

product_status.description: catalog-media: the product's own status (status also turns archived with its SKU)

cover_image_id.description: catalog-media: id of the position-0 photo, null when none

409.description: Conflict, stale version or insufficient inventory

get.description: Requires catalog:read. Metadata only (no bytes) in display order; position 0 is the cover.

403.description: Visible store but operation not permitted

404.description: Resource not visible in current scope

post.description: Requires catalog:write. Stores one photo at the next free position of an ACTIVE product (archived product or 8 images already: 409). Idempotency-Key replays the first result for the same file bytes; another file under the same key is 409. Body over 2 MiB + framing is 413 invalid_request; a non-multipart body is 415.

200.description: Committed result or exact idempotent replay

403.description: Visible store but operation not permitted

404.description: Resource not visible in current scope

409.description: Conflict, stale version or insufficient inventory

file.description: Exactly one part named file: JPEG, PNG or WebP, 1 byte to 2 MiB. The type is derived from the magic bytes; the part filename and Content-Type are ignored. SVG, GIF and any other format are refused.

get.description: Requires catalog:read. Merchant preview of one photo; the product in the path must own the image.

200.description: The stored bytes with their validated Content-Type

403.description: Visible store but operation not permitted

post.description: Requires catalog:write. Removes the photo and renumbers the rest so positions stay contiguous; allowed on an archived product. Returns the remaining images.

post.description: Requires catalog:write. ids must be exactly the product's current image ids in the desired order (a permutation); anything else is 409 so a stale client cannot drop or resurrect a photo.
